reviewer: publishing session, package R5 of the 20261028 round
scope: The open register's 20261028 version (plan section 3): a new dated file, open-register-20261028.json, and the dataset ladder flat in open-register-20261028.csv; open-register-20261020.json and .csv stay served byte-identical. Four MOABB record groups become this site's rows (Kim beta-range, MIND, Damm finger imagery, NeBULA), each checked end to end on the data-quality page; three models scored on the pilot studies page enter at step 4 (NeuroRVQ, EEG-Captioner, AXON); five models of the 2026-10-25 refresh enter at step 1 with holds. Every other row is rebuilt from the frozen 20261020 inputs.

approval.D13: A section on /topics/clinical-groups/ with its own question heading; the Parkinson's h1, short answer and card unchanged

round_20261028.D14: All: the seven SSVEP studies (rows 12, 14, 15, 20, 21, 32, 33), NeuroRVQ on EEGMAT, MI and P300 (aggregate scores only, CC BY-NC, no weights), the EEG-Captioner and AXON ten-second EEGMAT probes, and the Kim beta-range CCA baseline

rules.level: A row's level is the furthest step whose anchor item is on file (plan section 2.6, as both register pages state it); items missing at or below the level are its gaps. Three rows traced from their host records whose files were never opened (BNCI2014-004, PhysioNet eegmmidb, BI2013a) stand at step 3 with files opened as a gap at step 2. MIND stands at step 4 with its original terms (four statements that disagree) and its pinned version as gaps at step 3.
rules.share_above_chance: not computed (D12): a gap on every step-4 row where a chance level applies; not applicable on a one-person row (eldBETA, Damm, NeBULA)
rules.merges: external rows with merge_into are not rendered; their repo ids, MOABB loaders, DOIs and EEGDash mirror ids become aliases of the site row, and their source group is added to it
rules.terms: a site dataset row states its dataset page's terms (entities.ts), or the census's licence item (MIND: both licences side by side, D15); a model row states code, weights and data separately, each from the record it names
rules.aliases: NeBULA's files name a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.13627307) that is no registered record: it is not an alias of the row, and its derivation evidence cites the record that says so. NeuroRVQ's row lists the authors' weights only, as its payload cites them.
rules.checked: each row carries the day its evidence was checked: a row the 20261020 file holds unchanged in every other field keeps that file's date, because this freeze's re-read of its census values checked nothing new; new rows, and rows whose evidence changed, carry this freeze's day; external rows keep their evidence dates

site_holds.note: Each site row's hold is a finding with a reason code, sourced to its hold in releases.ts and in the payload that opens it (data-quality-update.json for eldBETA and ZuCo 2.0, dataset-checks-update.json for Kim beta-range, Damm and NeBULA), row by row (register_findings.SITE_HOLDS). A code is declared and attached only once site/src/data/open-register.ts words it in its holdReason table; until then the row's status and its case link state the hold. Kim beta-range's hold (amplitude units) replaces the onset-timing hold its MOABB record group carried.
